items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And, you know, Procope liked Jeff, too, because he and Jeff played together in Fletcher's band for a little while, you see.

ctx.x: And it was -- the two tenor players was like Mutt and Jeff, here was Dexter Gordon, and Dexter Gordon was so tall and Illinois was short, and they was the two tenor players in there.
